arxiv-1806-11189.title: A hybrid deep learning approach for medical relation extraction Conference: KDD Workshop on Machine Learning for Medicine and Healthcare; Aug 2018; London, United Kingdom
arxiv-1806-11189.creator: Veera Raghavendra Chikka, Kamalakar Karlapalem
arxiv-1806-11189.description: Abstract . Mining relationships between treatment(s) and medical problem(s) is vital in the biomedical domain. This helps in various applications, such as decision support system, safety surveillance, and new treatment discovery. We propose a deep learning approach that utilizes both word level and sentence-level representations to extract the relationships between treatment and problem.

arxiv-2303-10945.title: Open-World Pose Transfer via Sequential Test-Time Adaption
arxiv-2303-10945.creator: Junyang Chen, Xiaoyu Xian, Zhijing Yang, Tianshui Chen, Yongyi Lu, Yukai Shi, Jinshan Pan, Liang Lin
arxiv-2303-10945.description: Abstract Pose transfer aims to transfer a given person into a specified posture, has recently attracted considerable attention. A typical pose transfer framework usually employs representative datasets to train a discriminative model, which is often violated by out-of-distribution (OOD) instances.

arxiv-2310-01060.title: Elementary Building Blocks for Cluster Mott Insulators
arxiv-2310-01060.creator: Vaishnavi Jayakumar, Ciarán Hickey
arxiv-2310-01060.description: Abstract Mott insulators, in which strong Coulomb interactions fully localize electrons on single atomic sites, play host to an incredibly rich and exciting array of strongly correlated physics. One can naturally extend this concept to cluster Mott insulators, wherein electrons localize not on single atoms but across clusters of atoms, forming “molecules in solids”.

arxiv-2405-12205.title: Metacognitive Capabilities of LLMs: An Exploration in Mathematical Problem Solving
arxiv-2405-12205.creator: Aniket Didolkar, Anirudh Goyal, Nan Rosemary Ke, Siyuan Guo, Michal Valko, Timothy Lillicrap, Danilo Rezende, Yoshua Bengio, Michael Mozer, Sanjeev Arora
arxiv-2405-12205.description: Abstract Metacognitive knowledge refers to humans’ intuitive knowledge of their own thinking and reasoning processes. Today’s best LLMs clearly possess some reasoning processes. The paper gives evidence that they also have metacognitive knowledge, including ability to name skills and procedures to apply given a task.

arxiv-2406-01079.title: Object Aware Egocentric Online Action Detection
arxiv-2406-01079.creator: Joungbin An, Yunsu Park, Hyolim Kang, Seon Joo Kim
arxiv-2406-01079.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Joungbin An, Yunsu Park, Hyolim Kang, Seon Joo Kim. Advancements in egocentric video datasets like Ego4D, EPIC-Kitchens, and Ego-Exo4D have enriched the study of first-person human interactions, which is crucial for applications in augmented reality and assisted living. Despite these advancements, current Online Action Detection methods, which efficiently detect actions in streaming videos, are predominantly designed for exocentric views and thus fail to capitalize on the unique perspectives inherent to egocentric videos.

arxiv-2406-12026.title: Systematic literature review on forecasting and prediction of technical debt evolution
arxiv-2406-12026.creator: Ajibode Adekunle, Apedo Yvon, Ajibode Temitope
arxiv-2406-12026.description: Abstract Context : Technical debt (TD) refers to the additional costs incurred due to compromises in software quality, providing short-term advantages during development but potentially compromising long-term quality. Accurate TD forecasting and prediction are vital for informed software maintenance and proactive management. However, this research area lacks comprehensive documentation on the available forecasting techniques.

arxiv-2503-18419.title: Generative AI in Knowledge Work: Design Implications for Data Navigation and Decision-Making
arxiv-2503-18419.creator: Bhada Yun, Dana Feng, Ace S. Chen, Afshin Nikzad, Niloufar Salehi
arxiv-2503-18419.description: Abstract . Our study of 20 knowledge workers revealed a common challenge: the difficulty of synthesizing unstructured information scattered across multiple platforms to make informed decisions. Drawing on their vision of an ideal knowledge synthesis tool, we developed Yodeai, an AI-enabled system, to explore both the opportunities and limitations of AI in knowledge work.

arxiv-2601-18928.title: Center of double extension regular algebras of type (14641)
arxiv-2601-18928.creator: Andrés Rubiano
arxiv-2601-18928.description: Abstract . In this paper we compute the center and, in several cases, central subalgebras of double Ore extensions of type ( 14641 14641 ) under suitable restrictions on the defining parameters. Part of the analysis is supported by computations in SageMath . As an application, we provide new examples related to the Zariski cancellation problem.

britannica-1911-chislehurst.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-chislehurst.description: Article 'Chislehurst' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 6), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. division of Kent, England, 11¼ m. of London, by the South-Eastern & Chatham railway. It is situated 300 ft. above sea-level, on a common of furze and heather in the midst of picturesque country.

pmc-11476100.title: DNASimCLR: a contrastive learning-based deep learning approach for gene sequence data classification
pmc-11476100.creator: Minghao Yang, Zehua Wang, Zizhuo Yan, Wenxiang Wang, Qian Zhu, Changlong Jin
pmc-11476100.description: BackgroundThe rapid advancements in deep neural network models have significantly enhanced the ability to extract features from microbial sequence data, which is critical for addressing biological challenges. However, the scarcity and complexity of labeled microbial data pose substantial difficulties for supervised learning approaches.

pmc-12121694.title: Large Spin Hall Efficiency and Current‐Induced Magnetization Switching in Ferromagnetic Heusler Alloy Co2MnAl‐Based Magnetic Trilayers
pmc-12121694.creator: Mingzhi Wang, Chang Pan, Nian Xie, Xuepeng Qiu, Yufei Li, Lili Lang, Shiqiang Wang, Dashuai Cheng, Weijia Fan, Shi‐Ming Zhou, Zhong Shi
pmc-12121694.description: The spin Hall efficiency (ξ) is a crucial parameter that evaluates the charge‐to‐spin conversion capability of a material, and thus materials with higher ξ are highly desirable in spin–orbit torque (SOT) devices. Recent studies have highlighted the use of ferromagnetic materials as robust spin sources, paving the way for the development of more efficient SOT devices.

pmc-12364570.title: A mathematical model of corneal endothelium pump function
pmc-12364570.creator: Federica Vanone, Alexander J E Foss, Francesco Viola, Rodolfo Repetto, Mariia Dvoriashyna
pmc-12364570.description: The corneal endothelium plays a critical role in maintaining the transparency of the cornea by regulating water transport through the ‘pump and leak’ mechanism. This study presents a mathematical model to analyse fluid and ion pumping across the endothelium, accounting for two proposed mechanisms of the endothelial pump: local osmosis and electro-osmosis.

pmc-13139481.title: Multi-contrast laser endoscopy for in vivo gastrointestinal imaging
pmc-13139481.creator: Taylor L Bobrow, Mayank Golhar, Suchapa Arayakarnkul, Anthony A Song, Saowanee Ngamruengphong, Nicholas J Durr
pmc-13139481.description: White light endoscopy is the clinical gold standard for detecting diseases in the gastrointestinal tract. Most applications involve identifying visual abnormalities in tissue color, texture, and shape. Unfortunately, the contrast of these features is often subtle, causing many clinically relevant cases to go undetected.

pmc-13156248.title: PACS2 Alleviates Sepsis‐Induced Myopathy by Activating ERK–MAPK Signalling Pathway to Suppress ER‐Phagy
pmc-13156248.creator: Xuexin Li, Zu‐an Shi, Fei He, Guo Mu, Feixiang Wang, Bowen Sun, Xiaobin Wang, Li Liu
pmc-13156248.description: BackgroundSepsis‐induced myopathy (SIM) is a common and life‐threatening complication, but its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. PACS2, a key resident protein at mitochondria‐associated endoplasmic reticulum membranes (MAMs), regulates ER homeostasis under various pathological conditions. However, whether sepsis disrupts PACS2‐dependent MAM integrity, thereby triggering ER dysfunction and muscle wasting, remains unexplored.

pmc-13282796.title: RMAD1, a Novel Cell-Penetrating Peptide Derived from ADARB2: Preclinical Insights into Antigen Uptake and T Cell Activation
pmc-13282796.creator: Chaemin Lim, Chanho Park, Ee Chan Song, Yungyeong Shin, Wan Ki Kim, Yu Jin Park, Hyejoo Youn, Cheolmin Ham, Sang Bum Kim, Seongmin Cho
pmc-13282796.description: The development of effective cancer vaccines remains a major challenge in oncology, largely due to limited antigen delivery and suboptimal T cell priming. Here, we report RMAD1, a novel human-derived cell-penetrating peptide (CPP) originating from the ADARB2 (Adenosine Deaminase RNA Specific B2) protein, identified through an intra-dermal delivery technology (IDDT) platform, and evaluate its potential as a vaccine delivery enhancer.

pmc-13452922.title: Real-world adherence to and persistence with ofatumumab, infusion, oral, and other self-injectable disease-modifying therapies in patients with multiple sclerosis
pmc-13452922.creator: Ming-Hui Tai, Brandon Brown, Riley Taiji, Ariane Faucher, Francis Vekeman, Raluca Ionescu-Ittu, Abhijit Gadkari
pmc-13452922.description: BackgroundTreatment schedule complexity and route of administration may influence patient adherence and persistence. Limited real-world evidence exists comparing these outcomes across treatments for multiple sclerosis (MS).ObjectiveTo examine 18- and 24-month adherence/persistence of ofatumumab (OMB) and other approved disease-modifying therapies (DMTs).
